nodes.label: Springer Nature sn-jnl Template Conventions
nodes.rationale: Target journal changed to Machine Learning (Springer, 10994) on 2026-08-01. Template lives in journal_paper/ML_Template/. Supersedes the Elsevier CAS conventions, which are archived in journal_paper/archive_cas/.

nodes.label: Springer Front Matter Contract (SN001-SN008)
nodes.rationale: sn-jnl takes \title[running head]{}, \author*[1]{\fnm{} \sur{}}, \affil*[1]{\orgdiv...}, \abstract{} as a COMMAND not an environment, \keywords{} comma-separated, \maketitle, \bibliography{refs}.

nodes.label: Forbidden Preamble Constructs (SN010-SN012)
nodes.rationale: sn-jnl loads natbib and issues \bibliographystyle{sn-basic} itself, so a second natbib load is an option clash and a manual \bibliographystyle overrides the journal style. The highlights environment is Elsevier-only.

nodes.label: Springer Declarations Contract (SN013-SN014)
nodes.rationale: Springer wants \backmatter, \section*{Declarations}, and a \bmhead{} per declaration, using 'Not applicable' rather than omitting a heading. Author contributions replaces the CAS \printcredits.

nodes.label: Flat Folder Policy
nodes.rationale: Manuscript .tex and image assets stay flat in journal_paper/ so \input and \includegraphics never carry nested paths; enforced by lint CAS301-CAS305.

nodes.label: journal_paper/build.ps1 Lint/Build Gate
nodes.rationale: Final authority over template compliance. Compiles with pdflatex (sn-jnl is a pdflatex class), not xelatex as the retired CAS build did.

nodes.label: LaTeX Template Compliance Skill (sn-jnl)
nodes.rationale: Rewritten 2026-08-01 to enforce Springer sn-jnl instead of Elsevier CAS. The former 'CAS Abstract verbatimwrite Handling' rule is obsolete: that was cas-common.sty routing the abstract through \jobname.abs, which sn-jnl does not do.

nodes.label: MiKTeX Build Environment Notes
nodes.rationale: sn-jnl needs threeparttable, appendix and amscls (for amsthm.sty). A compile that hangs with a static log means MiKTeX is blocking on an on-the-fly install; run pdflatex -disable-installer to name the missing .sty.

nodes.label: Springer Bibliography Contract (sn-basic author-year)
nodes.rationale: sn-basic WITHOUT the Numbered option gives Springer Basic author-year, which is what Machine Learning uses. The class then loads natbib[authoryear], applies \setcitestyle{aysep={}}, and sets \bibliographystyle{sn-basic}. Switching to numbered is a documentclass option, never a \bibliographystyle.

nodes.label: ORCID / Orcidlogo.eps Caveat
nodes.rationale: sn-jnl defines \orcid{url} but it expands to \includegraphics{Orcidlogo.eps}, which does not ship with the template package. Enter the ORCID in the submission portal instead.

nodes.label: Single-File Submission Requirement
nodes.rationale: Springer asks for one .tex document. build.ps1 emits manuscript_sn_full.tex with every \input inlined; that is the file to submit.

nodes.label: Retired Elsevier CAS Front Matter
nodes.rationale: Holds the format-specific files only (manuscript_cas.tex, declarations_cas.tex, build_cas.ps1). Invisible to every glob because build.ps1 and verify_paper_numbers.py scan journal_paper/*.tex non-recursively. The seven section files were format-agnostic and were shared, not duplicated.
